Subject: Draft partner paper + marketplace entitlement flow

Jessica — attaching the next iteration of the partner paper and an entitlement mapping spreadsheet. We incorporated marketplace pass-through sequencing and clarified order form billing handoff. Two asks: 1) confirm CloudRelay is comfortable with the revenue pass-through clause in section 4.2 (we've proposed a net-of-commissions approach), and 2) propose an audit window you can accept — our legal prefers 60 days post-termination but we can be flexible.

Attached: Redlines_CloudRelay_Partner_Paper_v2.docx (docx)
RN-msa-orderform-entitlement-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Jessica Park <jessica@cloudrelay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@cloudrelay.com
Date: 2026-11-25T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft partner paper + marketplace entitlement flow

Ben — thanks for the docs. We reviewed with procurement and external counsel and pushed back on two main areas: 1) Indemnity carveouts in section 7 — they added reciprocal language and broadened the customer-facing liability carveout; 2) Audit window — Procurement insists on a 30-day audit initiation window after termination (they're worried about long tail access to reseller records).

I've attached our redlines. We're fine with the net-of-commissions price flow but we need explicit language on responsibility for chargebacks passed by the marketplace.

Attached: CloudRelay_Partner_Paper_v2_redlines.docx (docx)

Can we get legal to weigh in? If it's easier, we can hop on a quick call tomorrow morning PST.

Cheers,
Jessica Park
Head of Strategic Partnerships
CloudRelay Inc.
[Attachment: CloudRelay_Partner_Paper_v2_redlines.docx (docx)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T13:10:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudRelay redlines — legal triage request

Team — forwarding CloudRelay's redlines (see attachment). High level asks we need to resolve: 1) audit window (they want 30 days; we prefer 60 but can propose 45), 2) indemnity reciprocity and carveouts for marketplace-caused losses, 3) explicit call-out for chargeback handling from the marketplace to reseller and who eats adjustments.

Proposed internal split: Marissa/legal to lead indemnity and chargeback language; Laura to sign off on commercial exposure and SLA exception; Karthik to confirm operational implications to order form sequencing and the entitlement matrix. Ben — please keep procurement on this thread for any commercial trade-offs.

Can we aim to have legal comments back to CloudRelay within 48 hours? There's a DocuSign envelope waiting (link below) but we shouldn't send until redlines are aligned.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/HB-4820
DocuSign (pending): https://www.docusign.com/links/CR-PartnerPaper-HB4820

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CloudRelay_Partner_Paper_v2_redlines.docx (docx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CloudRelay redlines — legal triage request

Mina — thanks for the ping. Quick summary of my read:
- Indemnity: we should accept reciprocal indemnity narrowed to third-party IP claims and direct data breaches tied to our platform. Push back on broad customer-facing indemnity (CloudRelay's redlines go too wide).
- Audit window: 45 days is a reasonable middle ground. We'll add language that audit access is limited to reseller-specific records and that Redwood can redact customer PII in exported evidence.
- Chargebacks: propose that chargebacks originated from marketplace billing errors are pro-rated and netted via the order form reconciliation process; Redwood will require documented evidence before passing to reseller.

I'll attach a draft with inline comments and a tracked-changes doc for CloudRelay. If they insist on 30 days, we can agree only if they accept stricter scope and limit remedies (no punitive audit access).

Attached: RN_legal_response_PartnerPaper_v1.docx (docx)

On calls: I'm available tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PST for a quick triage.

Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RN_legal_response_PartnerPaper_v1.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica@cloudrelay.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft partner paper + marketplace entitlement flow

Jessica — appreciate the quick turnaround. Marissa and Laura are proposing a 45-day audit initiation window as a compromise; Marissa will provide a redline that explicitly limits scope to reseller records and requires proof-of-claim for any chargeback pass-through.

Operational note: Karthik, can you confirm whether the entitlement matrix supports an automated reconciliation export that meets proof-of-claim (transaction IDs, timestamps, reseller id)? If yes, we can call that out as required evidence in the partner paper and speed up audit cycles.

Proposed next steps: 1) Marissa sends tracked-change draft to CloudRelay by EOD today; 2) if CloudRelay accepts in substance, Mina to coordinate final DocuSign by Monday; 3) Ben to update HubSpot deal HB-4820 with the negotiated audit window and chargeback agreement.

Thanks — talk soon.
Ben

Team — thanks, that approach seems workable. We reviewed Marissa's notes and can accept 45 days if the scope is limited to reseller transaction records and Redwood provides the reconciliation export format as the primary proof-of-claim. We also agree to the net-of-commissions flow provided there is a mutual carveout for chargebacks that are clearly attributable to marketplace billing errors (we've asked our ops team to prepare a short runbook).

I'll route Marissa's tracked-changes doc to procurement and, assuming no further material edits, we can proceed to DocuSign early next week.

Appreciate the quick coordination — recommend Mina schedule the 30-min ops/finance sync to confirm export fields (transaction id, gross price, commission, timestamp, reseller id).
